replacementRows.reason: WO-1857 moved the login panel's connect CTA caption out of LoginPanelController.cs and into the string table. ConnectCtaLabel still resolves the *_google key under #if GOOGLE_PLAY, so this row is dead on that channel - but the canonical JSON that ships to Play would otherwise carry the wallet wording, which GooglePlayPackagingGate's ForbiddenTokens scan rejects a build over. Same disposition shape as onboarding.login_panel.title_wallet; the replacement keeps the channel-neutral sign-in terms already used by status_wallet_failed.

stripGroups.reason: These rows are owned only by DeNelle.Wallet, whose asmdef requires !GOOGLE_PLAY; storeWordmark is deliberately retained for the Play storefront.
The swap surface is unavailable on Google Play because DeNelle.Web3 requires !GOOGLE_PLAY.
The Settings wallet section and its refresh paths are compiled out of GOOGLE_PLAY.
